relevant_laws.quote: When the signal is circular green alone: Vehicular traffic facing the signal may proceed straight through or turn right or left unless another device at the place prohibits either or both such turns. Such vehicular traffic, including vehicles turning right or left, must yield the right-of-way to other vehicles and to pedestrians lawfully within the intersection or an adjacent crosswalk at the time the signal is exhibited.
relevant_laws.relevance_type: direct circular-green straight intersection right-of-way duty
relevant_laws.notes: Frozen branch selects a straight motor vehicle driver facing circular green alone.
